data.name: Field_RecipientKey_Help
data.value: Paste the recipient's armored PFA PUBLIC KEY block. The block carries both the recipient's X25519 public key (32 bytes) and their WebAuthn credentialId — the guided import on the recipient side uses the credentialId to drive WebAuthn directly to the matching passkey. The export uses ECIES (X25519 + AES-256-GCM) to wrap a fresh per-export key; only the holder of the matching private key can unwrap. No secrets cross between sender and recipient.

data.name: Confirm_ImportPool
data.value: This replaces every database currently stored with the ones in the file, and binds them to the passkey that file was made with. Your current passkey will no longer unlock them. Continue?

data.name: Hint_ImportOnLocked
data.value: Or import a full encrypted backup (.eds) to replace all databases and bind them to the passkey that backup was made with — useful for restoring a backup made with a different passkey (e.g. a YubiKey).

data.name: Confirm_Reset
data.value: This removes every database this app has stored in your browser and signs you out. Your computer's files are not affected. Continue?

data.name: Confirm_ResetEncrypted
data.value: This removes every database this app has stored in your browser, discards the encryption key and signs you out. Encrypted content is permanently unrecoverable without a backup. Your computer's files are not affected. Continue?
